# Anti-Corruption Department Targets PM Bench Leader

The government's own Anti-Corruption Department has asked Congress to lift the immunity of Pelan Avros, leader of the PM deputies. The investigation also names two OPP deputies and a director of the Corvel consortium. The Ledger notes that the department was created by this government.
